load_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model and weights from a checkpoint file path
match_state_dicts: match a model state dict with a checkpoint state dict to handle DataParallel key differences
load_state_dict_with_reporting: load a state dict into a module and report missing or unexpected keys
get_tensor_stats: compute max, min, std, mean, norm, and nonzero fraction stats for a PyTorch tensor
get_weight_table: get a table of all parameter names, shapes, weight stats, and gradient stats for a model
